success: new carried uu_b/vv_b values match every available oracle Kaa frame cellwise
non-NEMO states contain no uu_b/vv_b array leaf
restart continuation kt6-10 is bit-identical to the unbroken run
all Rule 8/12 movements and first_over_bar values are enumerated per card
stop_conditions: kt1 ordinary output or kt2 entry moves
carried Kaa fails against an available oracle frame
a non-NEMO recipe gains an array leaf

controls: perturb one carried face by three row-scale ulp and require the state/oracle gate to fail
drop either member of the pair and require construction/validation to fail
remove the pair from a restart and require the explicit logged legacy fallback only in the NEMO bridge
restart round trip must compare every state slot, not only u/v/T/S/eta
